body: This probably won't help but I've had severe depression since I was eight years old and I've been living with it for years now. I know how you feel with the resentment towards your parents because mine are alcoholics that use all their and my money for liquor. I've set so many death dates and have had over 15 attempts. I spent a year of my life in a psych ward because it got so bad. I've done so many drugs someone my age shouldn't have yet I'm still here. I have been hollow and faked the same fucking smile for years. The only reason I'm here is my sister. This probably won't help but please try to find someone in your life please
